sloka: इदं वचनमक्लीबं त्वया धर्मसमाहितम् ।व्याहृतं पुरुषव्याघ्र पृथिव्याः परिपालनम् ।। ७.८३.१८ ॥
transliteration: idaṁ vacanamaklībaṁ tvayā dharmasamāhitam ।vyāhṛtaṁ puruṣavyāghra pṛthivyāḥ paripālanam ।। 7.83.18 ॥

translations.english: O tiger among men, this firm speech, imbued with righteousness and concerning the protection of the earth, has been spoken by you.
